questions.question: For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?

questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.fld001) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab08 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld020 WHERE T1.fld002 = 24

questions.question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?

questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.fld045), AVG(T1.fld048) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT fld020, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM tab05 GROUP BY fld020 HAVING post_count > 10) AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld020

questions.question: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
questions.evidence: student badges refers to badge's fld003 = 'Student'; during 2010 refers to Year(fld004) = 2010; during 2011 refers to Year(fld004) = 2011; percentage difference = Subtract (Divide(fld035(fld003 where Year(fld004) = 2010), Count (fld003)) *100, Divide(fld035(fld003 where Year(fld004) = 2011), Count(fld003)) * 100)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', fld004) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(fld001) - CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', fld004) = '2011', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(fld001) FROM tab01 WHERE fld003 = 'Student'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) - CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student'
